answer: Honest side: newcomer locks 100, guarantor locks 200 for 15 epochs, at most 2 per epoch. Forgery side: a fake forfeits 100, the guarantor loses 50% plus 10 epochs of rights. Honest cost, 1,000 identities: 100,000 locked, zero lost. Forgery cost, 1,000 clones: 500 guarantors stake 100,000, 30% caught, 45,000 slashed. A saffron flag ripples to the guarantor; the anchor sinks with it. Honest pay a lock; forgers pay lock plus slash.
